title: András Tivadar Kulja
html:
Dr. András Tivadar Kulja is a Hungarian surgeon, digital health communicator, and politician. A prominent member of Hungary’s Tisza Party, he was elected as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) in June 2024, sitting with the European People's Party (EPP) group. Having earned his medical degree from Semmelweis University in 2016, initially training in psychiatry before transitioning to surgery. He has grown a consideranle social media following (notably on TikTok) creating health education content and fighting medical misinformation during and after the COVID-19 pandemic for which he was honored as Hungary's COVID doctor of the year for his public health myth-busting efforts.

In the European Parliament Dr Kulja serves as Vice-Chair of the Committee on Environment, Public Health and Food Safety (ENVI), acts as Vice-Coordinator for the EPP group in the Subcommittee on Public Health (SANT). He has also focuses heavily on health literacy, EU-wide healthcare collaboration, and shifting political narratives in Hungary.
